How It Works

Relax Your Feet in Just 15 Minutes

Pure comfort and light, refreshed feet — with three simple steps.

1

Put It On

Place the NeuroFlex™ Pro loosely around your foot — secure enough to stay in place, relaxed enough to unwind fully.

2

Select Your Mode

Press power, adjust intensity and heat. Choose massage, heat, compression — or all three in Fusion Mode.

3

Feel the Difference

Relax 15–30 minutes. Feel lighter, refreshed feet after every session — from the couch, your desk, or before bed.

Clinically Validated

Recommended by Orthopedic Specialists. Clinically Proven.

The NeuroFlex™ Pro was developed over more than a decade in consultation with leading orthopedic specialists, physiotherapists, and peripheral nerve health experts. It delivers the same three evidence-backed therapeutic methods used in professional clinical settings — now available at home, on your schedule.

The only approaches with consistent, peer-reviewed evidence for peripheral neuropathy and foot nerve pain are neuromuscular stimulation, deep heat therapy, and circulatory compression — used together. The NeuroFlex™ Pro is the first consumer device to combine all three in a single, easy-to-use system.

"I recommend devices combining neuromuscular stimulation, deep heat, and compression to patients in my practice with peripheral nerve issues. This is the most complete at-home clinical protocol I have seen at this price point." — Dr. R. Morrison, Orthopedic Physiotherapy Specialist
The Mechanism

Immediate Relief. Lasting Nerve Recovery.

Most remedies treat surface symptoms. The NeuroFlex™ Pro addresses the root cause: restricted blood flow, nerve signal disruption, and inflammatory buildup in the plantar arch.

1

EMS Micro-Pulses Awaken Dormant Nerves

Precisely calibrated electrical micro-pulses stimulate the 200,000 nerve endings in each foot, restoring conductivity in damaged pathways — reducing tingling, burning, and numbness at the source.

2

Far-Infrared Heat Penetrates Deep Tissue

Heat at 40–60°C penetrates 3–5 cm below the skin — deeper than conventional heat pads — triggering vasodilation, expanding blood vessels, and flushing inflammatory toxins that block nerve repair.

3

Dynamic Compression Restores Circulation

Sequential air compression drives lymphatic drainage, reduces swelling, and restores healthy circulatory return — providing the nutrient supply nerves need to regenerate at 2.5 cm per month.

What Makes It Work

The Most Effective At-Home Solution for Foot Nerve Pain

Three clinically-validated therapeutic systems in one device — targeting circulatory, neurological, and inflammatory root causes simultaneously.

EMS Pulse Massage

Three adjustable intensity modes deliver precise electrical micro-pulses that stimulate nerve endings and muscle tissue simultaneously — replicating physiotherapist-grade neuromuscular stimulation without an appointment.

Far-Infrared Heat Therapy

Five-level temperature control from 40°C to 60°C. Deep penetrating heat triggers vasodilation — expanding blood vessels and driving oxygen and nutrients directly to damaged nerve fibers.

Dynamic Air Compression

Graduated compression wraps the foot in a rhythmic squeeze-and-release cycle, mimicking the pumping action of walking to restore lymphatic drainage and reduce swelling that compresses peripheral nerves.

Fusion Mode

All three therapeutic systems engage simultaneously in a single 15-minute session — delivering the complete NerveRestore™ Protocol at home, with no clinic, no scheduling, no waiting room.

Universal Fit Strap

The extra-long, adjustable strap accommodates all foot sizes and shapes — secure enough to stay in place during use, and comfortable enough to forget you are wearing it.

Rechargeable & Portable

Fully rechargeable. No cables during use. Use it on the couch, at your desk, or before bed — the NerveRestore™ Protocol works wherever you rest, fitting into any routine without disruption.

The Science Behind It

Inspired by Clinical Research. Built for Daily Home Use.

We studied the evidence behind peripheral neuropathy treatment for over a decade — sourcing therapeutic protocols validated in peer-reviewed research, refined through consultation with orthopedic specialists and physiotherapists worldwide.

Common Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

Contact us at help@ortholabs.com

The NeuroFlex™ Pro is not a conventional vibration massager. Standard massagers address surface muscle tension. The NeuroFlex™ Pro combines three distinct therapeutic systems — EMS neuromuscular stimulation, far-infrared deep heat, and dynamic air compression — targeting the circulatory and neurological root causes of foot nerve pain. These are the same three methods used in physical therapy clinics. Most users begin noticing a reduction in tingling and burning sensations within two to three weeks of consistent daily use.
Most devices address only one mechanism — typically vibration or heat alone. Peripheral neuropathy is a multi-system condition: nerve signal disruption, restricted circulation, and inflammatory buildup all contribute simultaneously. A single-modality device will produce limited results. The NeuroFlex™ Pro's NerveRestore™ System engages all three mechanisms in a single session. If your previous devices were single-modality, this is a fundamentally different approach — not an incremental upgrade.
